practice.title: A calm morning
practice.body:
I get up and wash my face.
After breakfast, I put a book in my bag.
I am ready for school.
translation: 早饭后，我把一本书放进书包。
practice.question: What do I put in my bag?

practice.title: The lost sock
practice.body:
I look for my blue sock in my room.
It is not in the box or on the desk.
I find it under the bed.
translation: 我在房间里找我的蓝色袜子。
它不在盒子里，也不在书桌上。
practice.question: Where is the sock?

practice.title: A trip to the library
practice.body:
The library is near my home, so I go there on foot.
My friend lives far away and comes by bus.
We meet at the door and read together.
translation: 图书馆离我家近，所以我步行去那里。
我的朋友住得远，乘公共汽车来。
我们在门口见面，然后一起读书。
practice.question: How does my friend come?

practice.title: Our sports afternoon
practice.body:
I play ping-pong with my sister.
Our friends play football on the grass.
After playing, we drink some water and rest.
translation: 我们的朋友在草地上踢足球。
运动后，我们喝些水并休息。
practice.question: What do I play?

practice.title: My sky notebook
practice.body:
I draw a white cloud in my notebook.
At night, I look for the moon and stars in the sky.
I draw a small star beside the cloud.
translation: 我在笔记本上画了一朵白云。
夜里，我在天空中寻找月亮和星星。
我在云旁边画了一颗小星星。
practice.question: What do I draw beside the cloud?
practice.answer: A small star. 一颗小星星。

practice.title: Sea animals in a book
practice.body:
I see a dolphin in a book about the sea.
A little clownfish is on the next page.
I draw a seahorse and tell Dad about it.
translation: 我在一本关于海洋的书中看到一只海豚。
下一页有一条小小的小丑鱼。
我画了一只海马，并向爸爸介绍它。
practice.question: What animal do I draw?

practice.title: Four pictures
practice.body:
I draw flowers for spring and a fan for summer.
For autumn, I draw a yellow leaf.
For winter, I draw my warm coat.
translation: 我为春天画花，为夏天画扇子。
我为秋天画了一片黄叶。
我为冬天画了我的暖外套。
practice.question: Which picture has a yellow leaf?
practice.answer: The autumn picture. 秋天的画。

practice.title: Fruit for our picnic
practice.body:
We take an apple and a pear to the park.
Mum brings some grapes in a small box.
We wash our hands before eating the fruit.
translation: 我们带了一个苹果和一个梨去公园。
妈妈用小盒子装了一些葡萄。
吃水果之前，我们先洗手。
practice.question: What is in the small box?

practice.title: A morning in the park
practice.body:
I hear a bird and see a red flower.
I smell the flower and touch a smooth stone.
At home, I taste a piece of sweet pear.
translation: 我听见鸟叫，看见一朵红花。
我闻闻花香，摸摸一块光滑的石头。
回到家，我尝了一块甜梨。
practice.question: What do I hear?

practice.title: My little poster
practice.body:
My name is Amy, and I like to draw a picture after school.
I read a book with my family in the evening.
On Sunday, I help Dad make breakfast.
translation: 我叫埃米，我喜欢放学后画画。
晚上，我和家人一起读书。
星期日，我帮爸爸做早饭。
practice.question: What do I help Dad do?

practice.title: A day on the farm
practice.body:
We visit Grandma and Grandpa.
We feed the cows on their farm.
We have a good time together.
translation: 我们去看望奶奶和爷爷。
我们在他们的农场喂奶牛。
我们在一起玩得很开心。
practice.question: What do we feed?

practice.title: A tidy home
practice.body:
I tidy my room after breakfast.
Dad and I make the bed.
Then I put a clean dish on the table.
translation: 早饭后我整理自己的房间。
然后我把一个干净的盘子放在桌上。
practice.question: Where do I put the dish?

practice.title: A missing kite
practice.body:
I am upset because I cannot find my kite.
My friend helps me look for it.
We find it under a chair, and I am happy again.
translation: 我找不到风筝，感到难过。
我们在椅子下面找到了它，我又开心起来。
practice.question: How do I feel at the end?

practice.title: Our little robot
practice.body:
Our robot can play music.
My brother and I sing and dance.
The robot cannot cook, so we help Mum in the kitchen.
translation: 我们的机器人会播放音乐。
机器人不会做饭，所以我们去厨房帮妈妈。
practice.question: Can the robot cook?

practice.title: A new game
practice.body:
Lily and I play a game with a ball.
I do not know the game, but I have a go.
After the game, we talk and share our ideas.
translation: 我不了解这个游戏，但我试一试。
游戏结束后，我们交谈并分享想法。
practice.question: What do we play with?

practice.title: A thank-you picture
practice.body:
My mum is a teacher, and she likes her work.
Today I draw a picture for her.
She smiles and says it is a nice gift.
translation: 妈妈是一名老师，她喜欢自己的工作。
今天我为她画了一幅画。
她笑着说这是一份很好的礼物。
practice.question: What do I give Mum?

practice.title: A small garden
practice.body:
There is a tree in our garden.
A green leaf falls on the grass.
I draw a flower and watch a bee fly by.
translation: 我们的花园里有一棵树。
我画了一朵花，看见一只蜜蜂飞过。
practice.question: Where does the leaf fall?

practice.title: By the pond
practice.body:
Dad and I walk by a pond.
A duck swims past a green frog.
We stay on the path and watch them quietly.
translation: 爸爸和我在池塘旁散步。
一只鸭子游过一只绿色的青蛙。
我们待在小路上，安静地看着它们。
practice.question: What swims in the pond?

practice.title: Ready for lunch
practice.body:
My hands are dirty after playing outside.
I wash my hands before eating.
Now my hands are clean, and I am ready for lunch.
translation: 在外面玩过后，我的手脏了。
现在我的手干净了，我准备吃午饭。
practice.question: When do I wash my hands?

practice.title: A quiet evening
practice.body:
I read a story with Dad before bed.
Then I say good night to my family.
I close my eyes and go to sleep.
translation: 睡觉前我和爸爸读一个故事。
practice.question: Who reads with me?

李白乘舟将欲行，忽闻岸上踏歌声。
桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪伦送我情。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-020.detailReading: lǐ bái lǐ bái chéng zhōu jiāng yù xíng hū wén àn shàng tà gē shēng táo huā tán shuǐ shēn qiān chǐ bù jí wāng lún sòng wǒ qíng

moe-2022-zh-1-6-040.title: 《小儿垂钓》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-040.detail:
胡令能
蓬头稚子学垂纶，侧坐莓苔草映身。
路人借问遥招手，怕得鱼惊不应人。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-040.detailReading: hú lìng néng péng tóu zhì zǐ xué chuí lún cè zuò méi tái cǎo yìng shēn lù rén jiè wèn yáo zhāo shǒu pà dé yú jīng bù yìng rén

moe-2022-zh-1-6-019.title: 《望庐山瀑布》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-019.detail:
李白
日照香炉生紫烟，遥看瀑布挂前川。
飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-019.detailReading: lǐ bái rì zhào xiāng lú shēng zǐ yān yáo kàn pù bù guà qián chuān fēi liú zhí xià sān qiān chǐ yí shì yín hé luò jiǔ tiān

moe-2022-zh-1-6-003.title: 《敕勒歌》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-003.detail:
北朝民歌
敕勒川，阴山下。天似穹庐，笼盖四野。
天苍苍，野茫茫。风吹草低见牛羊。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-003.detailReading: běi cháo mín gē chì lè chuān yīn shān xià tiān sì qióng lú lóng gài sì yě tiān cāng cāng yě máng máng fēng chuī cǎo dī xiàn niú yáng

moe-2022-zh-1-6-075.title: 《村居》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-075.detail:
高鼎
草长莺飞二月天，拂堤杨柳醉春烟。
儿童散学归来早，忙趁东风放纸鸢。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-075.detailReading: gāo dǐng cǎo zhǎng yīng fēi èr yuè tiān fú dī yáng liǔ zuì chūn yān ér tóng sàn xué guī lái zǎo máng chèn dōng fēng fàng zhǐ yuān

moe-2022-zh-1-6-064.title: 《晓出净慈寺送林子方》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-064.detail:
杨万里
毕竟西湖六月中，风光不与四时同。
接天莲叶无穷碧，映日荷花别样红。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-064.titleReading: xiǎo chū jìng cí sì sòng lín zi fāng
moe-2022-zh-1-6-064.detailReading: yáng wàn lǐ bì jìng xī hú liù yuè zhōng fēng guāng bù yǔ sì shí tóng jiē tiān lián yè wú qióng bì yìng rì hé huā bié yàng hóng

moe-2022-zh-1-6-025.title: 《绝句（两个黄鹂鸣翠柳）》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-025.detail:
杜甫
两个黄鹂鸣翠柳，一行白鹭上青天。
窗含西岭千秋雪，门泊东吴万里船。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-025.titleReading: jué jù liǎng gè huáng lí míng cuì liǔ
moe-2022-zh-1-6-025.detailReading: dù fǔ liǎng gè huáng lí míng cuì liǔ yī háng bái lù shàng qīng tiān chuāng hán xī lǐng qiān qiū xuě mén bó dōng wú wàn lǐ chuán

moe-2022-zh-1-6-037.title: 《赋得古原草送别》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-037.detail:
白居易
离离原上草，一岁一枯荣。
野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。
远芳侵古道，晴翠接荒城。
又送王孙去，萋萋满别情。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-037.titleReading: fù dé gǔ yuán cǎo sòng bié
moe-2022-zh-1-6-037.detailReading: bái jū yì lí lí yuán shàng cǎo yī suì yī kū róng yě huǒ shāo bù jìn chūn fēng chuī yòu shēng yuǎn fāng qīn gǔ dào qíng cuì jiē huāng chéng yòu sòng wáng sūn qù qī qī mǎn bié qíng

moe-2022-zh-1-6-042.title: 《悯农（春种一粒粟）》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-042.detail:
李绅
春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子。
四海无闲田，农夫犹饿死。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-042.titleReading: mǐn nóng chūn zhòng yī lì sù
moe-2022-zh-1-6-042.detailReading: lǐ shēn chūn zhòng yī lì sù qiū shōu wàn kē zi sì hǎi wú xián tián nóng fū yóu è sǐ

moe-2022-zh-1-6-049.title: 《江上渔者》
moe-2022-zh-1-6-049.detail:
范仲淹
江上往来人，但爱鲈鱼美。
君看一叶舟，出没风波里。
moe-2022-zh-1-6-049.detailReading: fàn zhòng yān jiāng shàng wǎng lái rén dàn ài lú yú měi jūn kàn yī yè zhōu chū mò fēng bō lǐ

sh54-dizigui-conduct-excerpt.title: 《弟子规（节选）》
sh54-dizigui-conduct-excerpt.detail:
《弟子规》
冠必正，纽必结，袜与履，俱紧切。
置冠服，有定位，勿乱顿，致污秽。
唯德学，唯才艺，不如人，当自砺。
若衣服，若饮食，不如人，勿生戚。
sh54-dizigui-conduct-excerpt.detailReading: dì zǐ guī guān bì zhèng niǔ bì jié wà yǔ lǚ jù jǐn qiè zhì guān fú yǒu dìng wèi wù luàn dùn zhì wū huì wéi dé xué wéi cái yì bù rú rén dāng zì lì ruò yī fú ruò yǐn shí bù rú rén wù shēng qī

sh54-solar-terms-song.title: 《二十四节气歌》
sh54-solar-terms-song.detail:
传统歌诀
春雨惊春清谷天，夏满芒夏暑相连。
秋处露秋寒霜降，冬雪雪冬小大寒。
sh54-solar-terms-song.titleReading: èr shí sì jié qì gē
sh54-solar-terms-song.detailReading: chuán tǒng gē jué chūn yǔ jīng chūn qīng gǔ tiān xià mǎn máng xià shǔ xiāng lián qiū chǔ lù qiū hán shuāng jiàng dōng xuě xuě dōng xiǎo dà hán
